name: io.github.KhomDev/priorart
title: priorart
description: Audit-finding triage: prior art, exclusions and payability, as quoted evidence. Offline.

environmentVariables.name: PRIORART_MCP_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any path argument that resolves outside this directory.

environmentVariables.name: PRIORART_MCP_TIMEOUT_SECS

environmentVariables.name: PRIORART_BIN
environmentVariables.description: The priorart CLI to run (default: next to priorart-mcp, then PATH).
